name: omnisense/contracts
description: The contracts every omnisense provider family builds on, under any PHP host: a provider, its capabilities, its factory and configuration, the registry of an application's providers, JSON calls that keep credentials out of every error, the testing kit (recorded HTTP answers, the bare check) - and usage policies: a provider's rate limits, rights (commercial use, open source, caching, storage, attribution) and request requirements, declared as data, tightened by a site, enforced by a guard that also honours Retry-After and the RateLimit header fields.

suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Testing\: BareTestCase, the check that a package loads with what it requires alone
suggest.omnibridge/symfony: A RateLimiterInterface over symfony/rate-limiter, so that limits count across requests and servers
suggest.symfony/http-client: Testing\MockHttp: recorded answers over Symfony's MockHttpClient, every request kept as it went on the wire
